symptom: Fonts installed on the system are not available; only the bundled fonts are listed and used.
toml:
applies_if = []
known_fixed = ["designcraft", "effectcraft", "vectorcraft", "wordcraft"]
references = ["storytold/designcraft#36", "storytold/effectcraft#118", "storytold/vectorcraft#445", "storytold/wordcraft#233"]
title = "List installed system fonts in the font menus"
why = "Without it the font list misses installed fonts: only bundled fonts are shown, and fonts in macOS asset folders (such as the Chinese PingFang fonts), network font folders, or fonts that need a system scan don't appear."

[exempt]

[[fixed_if]]
grep = "com_apple_MobileAsset_Font|scan_system_in_background|/Network/Library/Fonts"
in = ["**/*.rs"]

[[proof]]
app = "designcraft"
pr = 36

[[proof]]
app = "effectcraft"
pr = 118

[[proof]]
app = "vectorcraft"
pr = 445

[[proof]]
app = "wordcraft"
pr = 233
reasoning: The fixes have no marker in common, so one regex covers each app's new marker: the macOS asset font folder prefix com_apple_MobileAsset_Font (designcraft; probably also wordcraft, since its bug is about Chinese fonts such as PingFang, which macOS installs as assets), the background system font scan scan_system_in_background (effectcraft), and the /Network/Library/Fonts folder (vectorcraft). Each one is added by its diff and is unlikely to be there before. I dropped broader terms (XDG_DATA_DIRS, AssetsV2, rescan_system, windows-registry), which could already be in vectorcraft or wordcraft and probably made attempt 2 match before the fix.
